name: Gift Collective (The Gift Trust)
summary: New Zealand charitable trust that holds funds and grants for charitable projects without a legal entity. Takes any charitable purpose, the environment included.

evidence.quote: Your Collective's activities must be of charitable purpose according to New Zealand law.
The Gift Trust is a NZ registered charity and not for profit.
TGT is a registered NZ charitable trust

projects.value: Charitable projects; environment is among the causes its Open Collective profile names

evidence.quote: nonprofit community support environment mental health and wellbeing

where.value: The benefit has to be in New Zealand

evidence.quote: You may spend Collective funds outside of New Zealand, but the benefit of those funds must be within New Zealand.
You may spend Collective funds outside of New Zealand, but the benefit of those funds must be within New Zealand.

value.note: one person can run a charitable project

evidence.quote: You're maybe just one person, or a group - but you all want to do something charitable.
you get to sit within our charitable entity, making you eligible to apply for charitable grants

fees.value: 8% of the first $200,000 a year, 6% of the next $300,000, 4% of the next $500,000, then by arrangement; the year starts on 1 April

evidence.quote: Amount raised per year (beginning each 1 April) Amount deducted On the first $200,000 8% On the next $300,000 (to $500k) 6% On the next $500,000 (to $1m) 4% On amounts above $1m By arrangement
Additional costs are deducted for payment processing, and for our employment services

fees.value: $2,000 NZD for each employee taken on, if you use its employment services

evidence.quote: $2,000 NZD is to be deducted for each new employee when they are onboarded

fees.value: $165 NZD per employee per month, if you use its employment services

evidence.quote: $165 NZD is to be deducted per employee per month

fees.value: It keeps the interest on your money

evidence.quote: all interest earned on the Fund will be retained by GC for its general fund

value.note: Its details go in as the applicant’s, unless the funder has a place for a fundholder’s.

evidence.quote: When applying for grants, use our details as the applicant's details, unless your funder allows you to provide separate details for your fundholder/umbrella organisation.

value.note: you or another incorporated entity must be the employer; it helps with payroll and HR

evidence.quote: we can help with payroll and HR, but you or another incorporated entity must be the legal employer
Your Collective's activities must be of charitable purpose according to New Zealand law.

conditions.value: Its approval before any grant application

evidence.quote: Applying for grants or signing a grant agreement without our prior authorisation is a violation of our Terms
Gift Collective does not accept Collectives with a primarily religious purpose.

conditions.value: Charitable work only; a business stays separate

evidence.quote: We can only accept charitable work, and expenses related to this. Some groups may choose to keep their business separate from their charitable arm, and run their charity work through us.

conditions.value: It reviews a grant application at least a week before the deadline

evidence.quote: Please give us at least a week to review your application before the due date.
